title: Full-Stack Security, Authorization, Integration, Migration, Concurrency and Reliability Hardening
scope: QA and minimal fixes only; no product functionality/model/schema/dependency changes

defects.defect: Login could issue a session after concurrent admin deactivation; later activation could revive it.
defects.reproduced: Paused session issuance after active/password check; login returned200 after deactivation.
defects.fix: Atomic guarded active-user no-op UPDATE inside issuance transaction, preserving updated_at.

defects.defect: Caller cancellation signal replaced transport deadline, allowing stalled queries to wait indefinitely.
defects.reproduced: Never-completing fetch with caller signal failed bounded-deadline test.
defects.fix: Compose cancellation/deadline with native AbortSignal.any; explicit120-second CSV timeout; preserve cancellation and safe body-read timeout errors.
defects.regression: frontend_hardening.test.mjs plus seven existing cancellation contract checks

defects.defect: Icon-only mobile navigation close button lacked accessible name.
defects.regression: Live DOM button and keyboard/label sanity checks

defects.defect: Legacy setup/recovery/verification copy contradicted working building/auth/admin capabilities.
defects.fix: Truthful existing Buildings link and email-specific unsupported-service wording; no wizard/new service.
defects.regression: Live route/setup journey and existing presentation regression

defects.defect: Browser profile HTML writes under the Vite-watched repository triggered unsolicited client page reloads during QA.
defects.evidence: Observed Vite log page reload events for Edge Wallet profile HTML files.
defects.fix: Validated OS temporary browser profile outside repository; keep only ignored evidence under generated/.
defects.regression: Harness asserts profile is within intended OS temp root and outside repository; browser smoke/combined workflow verifies cleanup.

defects.defect: QA form helper matched head meta[name=description] instead of textarea, making description XSS coverage vacuous.
defects.evidence: Review of successful screenshot showed Description not provided despite intended fixture input.
defects.fix: Scope helper to form controls; assert stored full_name/name/city/description through API and description-specific owner/admin DOM nodes.

defects.defect: Vite development static-file serving exposed SQLite-named files and generated QA logs without authentication, independently of backend route guards.
defects.reproduced: Only harmless self-created sentinels: root .db/.db-wal/.sqlite3 and generated log returned200 with sentinel bytes; real developer DB never read.
defects.fix: Extend wrapper Vite server.fs.deny with SQLite/sidecars, generated QA, backend and .venv protections; retain installed Vite default sensitive-file patterns.
defects.regression: verify_dev_file_access.py actual HTTP probes and normal page/module checks; auth/browser smoke and production build.
